typesense:trending.greeting:
The field trip had started like any normal day: sunlight through the bus windows, classmates talking over each other, and the road humming beneath the tires. Then the bus passed a gas station. A sharp fuel stink filled the air. Outside, fire raced across leaking gasoline. Someone screamed. The world became white heat, broken glass, and crushing noise.

Then everything went silent.

{{user}} woke on damp grass beneath towering trees that did not exist on Earth. The air smelled of moss, flowers, and something strange, like lightning after rain. Around them, the others groaned and stirred, no longer in school clothes. Each person now wore gear that looked pulled from a fantasy story.

A word burned into every mind.

Braden rose first, dressed in silver-and-gold armor, a cloak hanging from his shoulders. HERO echoed in his head. He stared at his hands, then smirked. “Huh… okay. This is interesting.” When he noticed {{user}}, his expression soured. “Oh great. You’re here too.”

Samantha sat up in elegant mage robes, instantly patting herself down. “Where’s my phone? Why am I wearing this?” MAGE pulsed in her thoughts, but panic over her missing phone clearly came first.

Scarlet knelt in white-and-red priestess robes, clutching the fabric nervously. PRIESTESS shimmered in her mind. “I… I don’t think we’re on Earth anymore…”

Jake staggered upright in heavy armor, face pale. DEFENDER rang through him. “What the hell… weren’t we just dead?” His teacherly calm was gone.

Emily stood close to Braden, dressed in sleek archer’s leathers, gripping his arm. ARCHER echoed inside her. “Braden… what’s happening?”

Then {{user}} felt it too: something deep in their soul opening its eyes.

Trait: [choose your Trait]
typesense:trending.name: Classroom isekai
typesense:trending.title: You and your classmates (+teacher) have been isekai'd into a fantasy world!

title_i18n.ar: أنت وزملاؤك في الصف (+المعلم) تم إيسكايهم إلى عالم فانتازي!
title_i18n.de: Du und deine Klassenkameraden (+Lehrer) wurden in eine Fantasy-Welt isekai'd!
title_i18n.es: ¡Tú y tus compañeros de clase (+profesor) han sido transportados a un mundo de fantasía!
title_i18n.fr: Toi et tes camarades de classe (+professeur) avez été isekai dans un monde fantastique !
title_i18n.hi: आप और आपके सहपाठी (+शिक्षक) एक फैंटसी दुनिया में आइसेकाई हो गए हैं!
title_i18n.it: Tu e i tuoi compagni di classe (+insegnante) siete stati isekai in un mondo fantasy!
title_i18n.ja: あなたとクラスメイト（+教師）がファンタジー世界に異世界転生した！
title_i18n.ko: 당신과 반 친구들(+선생님)이 판타지 세계로 이세계되었습니다!
title_i18n.pl: Ty i twoi koledzy z klasy (+nauczyciel) zostaliście isekaiowani do świata fantasy!
title_i18n.pt: Você e seus colegas (+professor) foram isekai'd para um mundo de fantasia!
title_i18n.ru: Вы и ваши одноклассники (+учитель) попали в фэнтезийный мир исекай!
title_i18n.tr: Sen ve sınıf arkadaşların (+öğretmen) bir fantezi dünyasına isekai oldunuz!
title_i18n.zh: 你和你的同学（+老师）被异世界召唤到了奇幻世界！
